title: Adding a field to a HogQL system table: what changes together
answers: What to change when adding a column to a system table?
Which snapshot needs updating for system table changes?
body:
- Postgres column first (Django model + migration).
- Add `*DatabaseField(name, nullable, description)` to the table in `database/schema/system.py` (`hidden=True` for internal cols like team_id; `ExpressionField` for derived ones; check override classes like `_ActivityLogsTable` fields/`get_predicates`).
- No registration for a new column on an existing table; a new table needs a `TableNode` in `SystemTables.children` (+ `access_scope` if controlled).
- Update snapshot `database/test/__snapshots__/test_database.ambr` (lists every system table's fields) and tests in `database/schema/test/test_system_tables.py`.
- Docs reference e.g. `products/posthog_ai/skills/querying-posthog-data/references/models-batch-exports.md` mention table columns and may need updating.
applies: System tables in database/schema/system.py; example traced via batch_export_backfills.
